remarks: Great multifamily investment with ton of future potential to increase rent roll. Desirable beach community. Unit 1 is approx 1,900 sqft 3 Bedroom 2 Full bath Townhouse with finished space in the walkout lower level to potentially add in-law. Unit 1 has 3 bedrooms upstairs, with spacious 1st floor including kitchen, family rm, dining room, EIK, and lower level finished space with washer/dryer. Plenty of lower level additional storage as well including walkout. Unit 2 is a 2 Bedrooms 1 1/2 baths townhouse that has month to month tenant in place. Open 1st floor plan with main entry on side of house. Unit 2 has a private storage area in lower level with washer dryer included as well.  Mechanical are all relatively newer. Hot-water heaters is 6 years old and furnaces are 12 years. Natural gas heat, central air, newer replacement windows, 10 year old roof, refinished driveway etc etc. Reasonable taxes in a great neighborhood close to everything. Great investment opportunity to make minor improvements to dramatically increase rent roll.
